failedRun.failure: A symmetric degree cap starved distinct new claims that legitimately attached to a shared old canonical anchor; coverage was 0.880435 against the frozen 0.9 gate.

rankingPasses: Select explicit SUPERSEDES governance candidates first.
Coverage pass: select one admissible candidate for every new-Source Claim endpoint before assigning that endpoint a second edge.
Cap degree only on new-Source endpoints. Old canonical anchors may connect to many distinct new topics but the source-wide audit budget remains hard.
Within equal detector confidence and Relation-type priority, use a domain-neutral endpoint lexical-affinity score before stable Relation id.
Fill the remaining source budget by Relation-type priority, confidence, lexical affinity and stable Relation id.

lexicalAffinity.inputs: Only the two endpoint Claim statements already available during compilation.
lexicalAffinity.method: Unicode-normalized lowercase word tokens plus CJK character bigrams; score is overlap divided by the smaller non-empty token set.
lexicalAffinity.purpose: Break otherwise arbitrary same-confidence ties toward the more specific endpoint pairing; it is not a truth verdict.

forbiddenInputs: Stage B answer or gold label
the two manually identified missed Relation ids

interpretationLimits: The repair changes audit scheduling only; it cannot publish a Relation or bypass semantic, type, condition and utility gates.
An uncapped old anchor is not an uncapped prompt: the hard per-source audit budget remains 24.
Lexical affinity is a generic tie-breaker and must never be reported as semantic correctness.
The repair is rejected if it merely selects the two known missed Relation ids without satisfying coverage, compression and a fresh deterministic deferred review.
